title: When the Signal Falls Anew
author: Ulyana Okonkwo
blurb: Coral Vasquez, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
